description: Prevents a known target session from inheriting a foreign active-task pointer.
changelog:
**Bug fixes:**
- Keeps session-scoped active-task resolution isolated when a known session has no usable pointer.
- Preserves identity-less single-session fallback for compatible sub-agent environments.

**Internal:**
- Restores the missing release manifest so adjacent-version `trellis update` paths remain complete.
notes: No project migration is required. Existing projects can run the normal `trellis update` flow.
